status_note: implementation_status describes the state of code verified by the named executed tests on Windows, not runtime acceptance tests AT-xxx, which are planned in docs/delivery/testing.md and executed separately. designed_not_built means only the spec exists.

requirements.title: Workspace discovery and trust
requirements.acceptance: Discover canonical root without executing project code; preserve dirty files and reject untrusted config escalation.
requirements.evidence: crates/bollo-workspace/src/root.rs units discovers_current_directory_without_executing_anything and rejects_missing_and_file_paths; tests/tests/negative_suite.rs project_configuration_cannot_widen_the_profile; dirty-file refusal preserved through checkpoints_preview_and_refuse_user_edits and golden_edit_verify_restore.

requirements.title: Two provider adapters
requirements.acceptance: Pass text/tool/fragment/error/cancel fixtures for Anthropic Messages and xAI Chat Completions with origin-bound credentials.
requirements.evidence: crates/bollo-providers/src/anthropic.rs parses_text_and_fragmented_tool_arguments; xai.rs parses_fragmented_tool_call_arguments; stream.rs assembles_fragmented_arguments_into_one_intent; fake.rs typed cancel/exhaust errors. Live HTTPS transport is feature-gated; no CI job contacts a vendor.

requirements.title: Bounded agent loop
requirements.acceptance: Complete deterministic edit/test workflow, serialize effects, stop at configured ceilings, and never dispatch partial tool arguments.
requirements.evidence: tests/tests/golden_scenario.rs golden_edit_verify_restore, run_limit_stops_the_loop_with_exit_4, cancellation_maps_to_130_and_runs_nothing; crates/bollo-core/src/scheduler.rs serializes effects; stream assembly dispatched only complete tool arguments.

requirements.title: Typed built-in tools
requirements.acceptance: Validate all seven tool schemas; reject malformed arguments and path escapes before effects.
requirements.evidence: crates/bollo-tools/src/lib.rs registry of the seven tools (read_file, search, write_file, apply_patch, exec, git_status, git_diff); prepare.rs read_file_prepares_workspace_scoped_intent and write_binds_target_preimage; execute.rs stale_write_is_refused_at_execution.

requirements.title: Explainable permission presets
requirements.acceptance: Apply four presets and deny/ask/allow precedence with provenance; demonstrate all policy fixtures including negative cases.
requirements.evidence: crates/bollo-policy layers/normalize/evaluate/gate units; tests/tests/negative_suite.rs deny_beats_ask_and_allow_for_the_same_intent, read_only_is_an_inspection_ceiling_no_rule_can_unlock, an_explicit_ask_stays_an_ask_under_unrestricted; examples/policy-cases.json validated by scripts/validate_docs.py.

requirements.title: Verified execution boundary
requirements.acceptance: Probe filesystem and tool-network containment; refuse workspace_auto when required enforcement is absent; never silently run on host.
requirements.evidence: crates/bollo-workspace/tests/container_escapes.rs (6 escape tests); CLI workspace_sandbox_is_verified_or_refused_but_never_host_fallback and workspace_mode_runs_exec_children_inside_the_container; python scripts/containment_evidence.py 8/8, CI-published artifact. The container backend is the Windows AppContainer; workspace_auto on other systems refuses rather than pretending.

requirements.title: Scoped approvals
requirements.acceptance: Bind approval to exact intent/hash/revision/expiry and atomically consume it; concurrent or stale requests cannot execute twice.
requirements.evidence: crates/bollo-policy/src/approval.rs approved_receipt_is_single_use and stale_revision_or_preimage_is_refused; gate.rs approved_receipt_authorizes_once and mismatched_expectation_is_stale; tests/tests/classifier.rs escalated_approval_keeps_intent_hash_and_stays_consumable_once.

requirements.title: Durable sessions and recovery
requirements.acceptance: Kill at operation boundaries; resume as interrupted/unknown without auto-replaying side effects; retain ordered events.
requirements.evidence: tests/tests/recovery.rs stale_operation_becomes_unknown_and_is_never_replayed and unknown_operations_survive_later_runs_in_the_same_store; crates/bollo-store/src/lib.rs units operation_intent_is_journaled_before_result, events_append_with_monotonic_seq_and_replay_in_order, interrupted_runs_are_detectable; SQLite journal engine per ADR-015 (rusqlite 0.32, WAL, synchronous=FULL).

requirements.title: Safe patches and restore
requirements.acceptance: Refuse stale preimages and ambiguous replacements; restore only matching postimages; preserve pre-existing user edits.
requirements.evidence: crates/bollo-workspace/src/fs.rs write_requires_matching_preimage and duplicate_fragments_are_ambiguous; checkpoints.rs restores_only_matching_postimage, binary_or_oversize_preimages_disclose_unavailable_restore; tests/tests/golden_scenario.rs golden_edit_verify_restore.

requirements.title: Usage and budgets
requirements.acceptance: Track reservations, nullable unknown spend, tool/time/token ceilings; stop finite-spend runs when pricing is unknown.
requirements.evidence: crates/bollo-core/src/budget.rs units; a spend cap without prices blocks with pricing_unknown exit 1 (observed; getting-started refusals table); run_limit_stops_the_loop_with_exit_4; crates/bollo-store run_summaries_aggregate_usage_and_keep_newest_first with contract-mandated nullable unknown cost.

requirements.title: Keyboard terminal UX
requirements.acceptance: Complete setup, approval, diff and recovery keyboard-only at 80 and 120 columns with no-color mode.
requirements.evidence: Verified offscreen over injected streams: crates/bollo-tui/src/present.rs width_is_respected_at_80_and_120_columns and no_color_path_never_emits_ansi; terminal.rs absent_or_ambiguous_answers_are_not_approval and closed_input_blocks_instead_of_defaulting_to_yes; slash.rs command units; CLI interactive_session_drives_the_real_runtime drives the live session object. Gap: input is line-based, with no raw mode, keystroke events, redraws or scrolling; what the user saw is not asserted visually offscreen; a real terminal session was never used. Stack decided and ratified (ADR-016: ratatui 0.30 + crossterm, 2026-10-17); the port is not yet implemented, so the raw-mode gap stands.

requirements.title: Deterministic headless interface
requirements.acceptance: Emit schema-valid NDJSON only on stdout; ask without a user blocks with exit 3; cancellation maps to 130.
requirements.evidence: crates/bollo-cli/tests/cli.rs headless_ndjson_stdout_is_machine_only, headless_ask_blocks_with_exit_3, invalid_arguments_exit_2, interactive_without_a_terminal_is_exit_2; tests/tests/golden_scenario.rs cancellation_maps_to_130_and_runs_nothing; events closed vocabulary via negative_suite event_shapes_are_closed.

requirements.title: Bounded context and instructions
requirements.acceptance: Record context provenance and preserve complete tool pairs during compaction; repository instructions never change permissions.
requirements.evidence: crates/bollo-core/src/context.rs discovers_instructions_with_provenance; compaction.rs units including a_single_oversized_turn_is_reported_not_mangled; instructions are data, not permissions, and cannot widen the profile (negative_suite project_configuration_cannot_widen_the_profile).

requirements.title: MCP stdio tools
requirements.acceptance: Trust startup separately; negotiate pinned protocol, namespace tools, route through gate, and handle mid-call failure without replay.
requirements.evidence: crates/bollo-extensions/tests/mcp_stdio.rs untrusted_startup_is_refused, discovered_mcp_tools_join_the_model_list_and_pass_the_gate, denied_approval_never_reaches_the_server, mid_call_death_is_journaled_unknown_exactly_once, server_reported_tool_error_is_failed_not_unknown, announced_tool_list_changes_refresh_the_model_view_mid_run; src/trust.rs units; CLI mcp.rs contract tests and doctor untrusted reporting. Remote (Streamable HTTP) MCP is BH-018 and not built.

requirements.title: Trusted lifecycle hooks
requirements.acceptance: Before-hook veto/error/timeout denies action; after-hook failure cannot falsify results; no recursive authorization bypass.
requirements.evidence: crates/bollo-extensions/tests/hooks_stdio.rs drives real hook processes through the hook_fixture binary; hooks.rs untrusted_hook_never_spawns; hooks receive no authority: the after-hook result cannot alter an already-recorded verdict, and authorization stays with the single-use approval receipts.

requirements.title: Privacy and credential isolation
requirements.acceptance: Seed secret canaries; verify no provider secrets in child env, normal logs or redacted exports; verify deletion and retention semantics.
requirements.evidence: Credential stores stay outside every container grant (crates/bollo-workspace/tests/container_toolchain.rs credential_stores_stay_outside_every_grant); the child-environment allowlist excludes credential-looking names and values (process.rs environment_is_filtered, strengthened by the root privacy suite's credential_canary_never_reaches_a_child_env_journal_or_export); provider secrets never reach the journal, run summaries or sessions export because tool.proposed records intent hashes and tool.result records summaries (events.md contract, held by privacy.rs proposal_and_result_surfaces_carry_metadata_not_bodies), and the CLI test asserts the usage contract; deletion semantics: sessions delete now cascades artifact rows (store units sessions_can_be_listed_and_deleted_without_touching_source, privacy.rs deletion_cascades_artifact_rows_...), and content_retention_days is enforced by `bollo sessions prune` (store functions tested in tool_output_artifacts_expire_while_durable_classes_stay, a_body_shared_with_a_durable_row_survives_pruning, retention_respects_the_cutoff..., and exercised end-to-end in sessions_list_export_and_delete).

requirements.title: Optional local HTTP API
requirements.acceptance: Conform to all OpenAPI routes; enforce bearer scopes, Host/Origin and workspace ownership; replay SSE and validate idempotency.
requirements.evidence: crates/bollo-api/tests/http.rs (18 checks including approval_decision_is_single_use_and_binding plus auth, idempotency, events and wire units) pass — the crate is real and tested. Gaps: bollo-api is not a dependency of bollo-cli and no `bollo api`/`serve` command starts it, so the full OpenAPI/SSE conformance run in AT-017 has not been executed.

requirements.title: MCP Streamable HTTP
requirements.acceptance: Pass version/session/reconnect/OAuth/resource-binding/SSRF tests against independent reference servers.

requirements.title: ACP client adapter
requirements.acceptance: Negotiate a pinned ACP version and translate sessions/prompts/updates/permissions/cancel without creating a second tool gate.

requirements.title: Read-only bounded subagents
requirements.acceptance: Child cannot exceed parent capability or budget; cancellation propagates; read-only scope cannot mutate through shell or MCP.

requirements.title: Advisory risk classifier
requirements.acceptance: Escalate only: classifier hints turn allow into ask at most and never grant, widen or deny; disabled, failing, malformed or untrusted responses leave the policy decision unchanged; deny/ask, read-only effects and unselected profiles produce zero calls.
requirements.evidence: tests/tests/classifier.rs: escalating_hint_turns_allow_into_ask_and_is_audited, zero-call guards (ask/deny policies, read-only effects, unselected profile), unavailable_verdict_is_fail_neutral, and exported NDJSON byte-identical with and without a classifier; crates/bollo-policy/src/classifier.rs escalation_is_monotone_and_only_allow_changes plus a bounded redacted projection; typesafe.rs transport keeps a pinned HTTPS origin and only an env-named credential; CLI tests enforce default-disabled and never-blocks-a-turn posture. Adopted by OD-11 on 2026-10-17 (default-disabled, opt-in); the vendor path stays unexercised and no CI job contacts a provider.
